description: Track and edit Backlog.md tasks across your BB projects. Filter and sort a live Kanban board, move cards between statuses, and open tasks for Markdown and inline edits with conflict checks. Requires BB 0.43+, Plugin SDK 0.4.87 through 0.4.x, and an existing task folder on an enrolled host; no Backlog CLI or external account is needed. The interface is light-only, uses experimental BB APIs, and has been tested on macOS; Windows host paths are unverified.
